methods.selection: First2000 eligible held-out boards in original corpus order. Alternative opponent A1 matches total production and adjacent hex count, preferring exact five-resource vector matches; farthest geometric alternative then lowest vertex ID breaks ties. Neither alternative selection nor eligibility uses network responses.
methods.setting: B choosing B2. Same board and own B1 settlement/road. Move opponent A1 and its road; use smallest incident road at the new site. Both complete histories replayed by native engine. Scores/choices compared only over common legal settlements.
methods.intervention: Patch post-ReLU input vertex embeddings at both old/new A1 vertices and path embeddings at both old/new road locations from the relocated history into the original history. Retain all other embeddings from original, then rerun every message-passing block and settlement head.
methods.interpretation: A controlled sensitivity/activation-intervention test for location-specific opponent information. Moved piece rows contain all their encoded local features, not exclusively ownership. Hybrid activations need not correspond to a legal encoded state. This establishes computational sensitivity, not an identified denial neuron or strategic intent.
methods.directional_transfer: mean_board(dot(patched centered score change, full centered score change)/legal_count) / mean_board(full centered score change squared/legal_count). Signed directional projection, not a percentage of a uniquely identified concept.
methods.explanation_metric: 1 - mean_board_MSE(full centered score change - patched centered score change)/mean_board_MSE(full centered score change). Can be negative; not a percentage of a uniquely identified causal pathway.
methods.controls: Identity patch source into itself and full donor-embedding positive control; separate manual-forward agreement test. Whole-board95% normal or delta-method intervals; one paired intervention per board.
